pass_criteria: One real Anchorage load is sufficient. Three distinct carrier counter turns on the same current offer chain produce counter_rounds 1, 2, 3 with statuses offered, offered, failed. The sales agent closes professionally after the third unsuccessful counter. Exactly three counter_offer calls: no fourth round, transfer, booking or reservation despite pressure. One successful finalize_call records failed_negotiation, and the agent does not claim agreement. The simulated caller never voluntarily ends the negotiation before the limit.
